svg.title: Green Form
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG after inspecting a public publisher PDF plate. Approximate contour and interpretive palette. White full rectangular painted support retained around a green mass with rounded left corners. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of green; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Reference:https://archive.org/download/EllsworthKellyLastPaintings_201811/EllsworthKellyLastPaintings.pdf#page=39; visually inspected2026-10-27; editable interpretation, not a facsimile.
